movies.title: Cyberpunk 2099: Neo-Veridia
movies.description: In the high-density megacity of Neo-Veridia, rogue neural algorithms infiltrate the distributed cloud mainframe. A hacker-detective must bypass load-balanced firewalls before total singularity.
movies.cast: Kenji Sato, Elena Rostova, Marcus Vance

movies.title: Interstellar: Beyond The Event Horizon
movies.description: A deep space reconnaissance expedition travels across cosmic rings and swirling sapphire nebulae to discover an ancient planetary beacon emitting quantum transmission pulses.
movies.cast: Dr. Joseph Cooper-Smith, Amanda Brand, TARS-9

movies.title: Silicon Siege: Zero-Downtime Protocol
movies.description: When an unprecedented DDoS vector attacks the continent-wide streaming backbone, an elite DevOps team initiates emergency Least-Conn rerouting to survive zero-downtime failover.
movies.cast: Navya Rangwani, Jass Shivnani, Khushi Sadhuramani

movies.title: The Dockerfiles: Container Protocol
movies.description: The definitive architectural documentary chronicling the revolution from monolithic bare-metal streaming to microservice orchestration with Docker Compose, NGINX Layer 7 load balancing, and HLS byte-range streaming.
movies.cast: VESIT D7A Batch 2 Group 5 Engineering Unit

movies.title: Tokyo Velocity: Midnight Drift
movies.description: Under the neon lights of Shinjuku and Shibuya, modified high-output twin-turbo machines battle on rain-slicked asphalt while an underground telemetry stream broadcasts to millions across distributed nodes.
movies.cast: Ren Takahashi, Maya Chen, Dominic Torre-Sim
